title: brca12-wgs: BRCA1/BRCA2 germline analysis from whole-genome sequencing (GRCh38)
description: Nextflow pipeline for BRCA1/BRCA2 germline analysis from whole-genome sequencing on GRCh38: BWA-MEM, samtools, GATK HaplotypeCaller or DeepVariant, Manta, CNVkit, Ensembl VEP with ClinVar and mosdepth exon coverage. Produces separate SNV/indel, CNV and SV results, ACMG/AMP criterion hints (ENIGMA thresholds, no classification), exon-level coverage with uncertain regions flagged, and HTML/Markdown/JSON reports. Research use only: results must not be interpreted medically without clinically validated confirmation.
